blocks.content: Course: Python Numpy for Data Science
There are various universal functions in NumPy. We will discuss the following functions.

items: Arithmetic functions like add(), subtract(), and multiply()
Trigonometric functions like sin(), cos(), and tan()
Aggregation functions like mean(), min(), and max()
